items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Jenny Dilliard, this pianist, she was a friend of Harry's and she had heard me sing around... she got in touch with me and told me to go down and audition.

MS. SULLIVAN: Well, Jenny Dilliard, this

pianist, she was a friend of Harry's and she had heard me sing around, probably around the house. See Harry and the boys used to, at times, rehearse at home and they would bring people like Jenny and some of their colleagues, some of the entertainers around, and they would have parties at the house and they had heard me sing. So when Jenny got this job at the Benjamin, Harris, and Literary Club which is 966 Liberty Avenue in downtown Pittsburgh. A very small club, an after-hours club. And so she got in touch with…
